metaTitle: Custom Gold Awards Recognition | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom gold awards recognition for your team. Perfect Imprints offers bulk pricing on plaques, medals, and more.
introHtml: Gold awards recognition pieces carry a timeless prestige that sets them apart from standard colors. Whether you are honoring years of service with a Farnsworth/Texetch™ Plaque or celebrating a top performer with a Laurel Wreath Medal, the gold finish adds a sense of achievement and value. These items work well for annual banquets, safety milestones, or retirement ceremonies. Custom engraving or screen printing allows you to add names, dates, and logos directly onto the gold surface, creating a keepsake recipients will display proudly.
heroAltText: Custom gold awards recognition plaque and medal set with engraved text and gold finish
